scope: Source-only route inventory from five actually installed v34 family manifests, actual two principal HTML link sets and the new stage mapping. No staged HTML or HTTPS response hash is inferred from reader bytes; selector injection and public route rewriting change delivery bytes. Root must use the eventual validated stage for TLS byte comparisons.
query_policy: Listed paths are canonical path-only requests. Use a separately chosen cache-busting query if required; it is not part of the stage-relative filename.
